what_happened.line: The School Committee voted on the paraprofessional agreement, the cafeteria agreement and a non-affiliated policy document with changes; the minutes record no audible outcomes.
The paraprofessional contract adds a capped reimbursement pool for professional development.
A family donation to fund a speaker system in the new stadium was put to a vote; the outcome was not audible.
The athletic director was to submit a blanket eighth-grade waiver application for fall sports.
Consultants presented the district strategic plan, and summer meetings were set to focus on goals and the plan.

why_it_matters: The three employee agreements set pay and benefit terms for school staff, which are paid from the school budget, mostly taxes, so they shape future budget requests.
The eighth-grade waiver decides whether younger students can join high school fall teams, and the stadium donation covers equipment that would otherwise need funding.
